caption: The drawing depicts a single, medium-sized bowl positioned centrally on a plain, cream-colored background. The bowl is rendered in shades of grey, white, and light brown, with darker shading to create depth and transparency, typical of glass or crystal. The bowl features a scalloped rim with six segments, each decorated with a pattern that includes etched oval shapes surrounded by leaf-like motifs. The bowl's interior bottom displays a starburst design with alternating dark and light segments, and additional geometric detailing is present on the bowl's lower sides. The artist’s signature, “J. McFerry,” is visible in small red script to the lower right of the bowl. The overall composition is simple, with the bowl placed in the center and ample empty space around it.
title: Dessert Dish
